lines.text: Every day, local bakeries and restaurants discard fresh, delicious food simply because it went unsold. Meet FoodLink—the smart marketplace turning surplus food into affordable meals.
It begins with the merchant. In seconds, a bakery owner lists excess croissants and surprise meal boxes at up to 60 percent off, setting an easy pickup window before closing.
On the customer side, an instant notification fires. Nearby diners browse live surplus deals, seeing great food, huge savings, and exact collection times.
With a single tap, the customer reserves the meal and receives a verified 4-digit pickup code—guaranteeing their bag is held safe and ready.
The merchant's terminal pings in real time. The order enters the active queue, allowing staff to prep the bag with zero friction.
At pickup, the customer presents their code. The merchant enters the digits, clicks verify, and handoff is confirmed instantly.
Merchants recover revenue. Customers save money. Communities reduce waste. Join FoodLink today and turn surplus into value.

bgm.blob: FoodLink enables merchants to sell surplus meals at a discount and customers to reserve in real-time, reducing food waste through a seamless verification code pickup.
